examples.description: Read one quote with its totals

failure_modes.recovery: Call quote_list (or quote_search with the quote number) and resend with a listed id.
failure_modes.when: the id does not name a quote in your tenant

description: Returns one quote with subtotal_cents, tax_cents and total_cents worked out from its live lines (integer CENTS) and effective_status, which reads 'expired' once a sent quote's valid_until has passed (the stored status never says so). A quote with a tax_scheme also returns tax_summary (each line's tax code, net, tax and gross, and the per-code totals). Refuses an unknown id with NOT_FOUND: find the id with quote_list or quote_search.
name: quote_read
